title: Refactor Chatbot plugin for AI SDUI integration with service-ai and vercel/ai SDK
body:
Refactors the chatbot plugin (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`) to support full AI SDUI integration with `service-ai` backend and `vercel/ai` SDK (`@ai-sdk/react`). The plugin now supports two operating modes — **API mode** (SSE streaming via service-ai) and **Local mode** (legacy auto-response for demos) — auto-detected based on the `api` schema field.

## Changes Made

### Dependencies
- Added `ai` (^6.0.141) and `@ai-sdk/react` (^3.0.143) as dependencies in plugin-chatbot

### Types (`@object-ui/types`)
- Extended `ChatMessage` with `streaming`, `toolInvocations` fields and `tool` role
- Added `ChatToolInvocation` interface for tool-calling flows (`toolCallId`, `toolName`, `args`, `result`, `state`)
- Extended `ChatbotSchema` with `api`, `conversationId`, `systemPrompt`, `model`, `streamingEnabled`, `headers`, `body`, `maxToolRoundtrips`, `onError`
- Updated corresponding Zod validation schemas

### `useObjectChat` Hook (new)
- Composable hook that always calls `useChat` from `@ai-sdk/react` (static ESM import) to satisfy Rules of Hooks, with mode locked on first render via `useRef`
- In API mode, delegates to `useChat` for SSE streaming; in local mode, `useChat` is initialized with a placeholder endpoint and its results are ignored
- Exposes `messages`, `isLoading`, `error`, `sendMessage`, `stop`, `reload`, `clear`, `isApiMode`, `input`, `setInput`, `handleInputChange`
- `onSend` callback consistently includes the newly sent user message in both API and local modes
- Auto-response timer includes `useEffect` cleanup on unmount and `clear()` cancels pending timers via `stop()`
- Exported from package index for custom integrations

### Renderer Refactor (`renderer.tsx`)
- Both `chatbot` and `chatbot-enhanced` registrations now use `useObjectChat` instead of inline `useState`/auto-response logic
- New schema fields (`api`, `conversationId`, `systemPrompt`, `model`, etc.) are wired through to the hook

### ChatbotEnhanced Component
- Added `onStop`, `onReload`, `isLoading`, `error` props
- Added streaming controls UI: Stop button (during streaming), Retry button (on error), error alert display
- Extracted `isInputDisabled`/`isSendDisabled` computed variables for consistent disabled state handling

### Tests (20 hook tests passing)
- 20 `useObjectChat` hook tests: initialization, message sending, auto-response, stop, clear (including timer cancellation), input management, edge cases
- 10 streaming/error feature tests: stop button, reload/retry, error display, loading state, streaming indicators
- 15 existing `ChatbotEnhanced` tests remain unchanged

### Storybook Stories
- Added 3 new AI SDUI stories: `AIStreamingMode`, `AIWithSystemPrompt`, `AIWithToolCalls`

### Documentation
- Updated `plugin-chatbot.mdx`: schema API (14 new fields), properties table, operating modes section, tool role documentation (accurately describing current rendering behavior for `tool` role messages), TypeScript support, ChatMessage shape aligned with actual types
- Updated `README.md`: AI streaming mode usage, `useObjectChat` hook example, mode comparison table
- Updated `CHANGELOG.md` and `ROADMAP.md`

## Security
- CodeQL: 0 alerts
- Dependencies checked against GitHub Advisory DB: no vulnerabilities
